capabilities.name: Buy inside an AI assistant
capabilities.question: Can an AI assistant buy from a merchant for you without you leaving the chat?

US.note: Google AI Mode and Gemini (agentic checkout and Universal Cart), Microsoft Copilot Checkout, Perplexity Instant Buy with PayPal and Alexa+ shopping all work for US users; ChatGPT Instant Checkout launched in the US but OpenAI moved checkout to merchant apps in March 2026.

GB.note: Only Alexa+ early access (invite or new Echo buyers, since March 2026) can order from Amazon by voice; Google says UCP checkout in AI Mode and Gemini will reach the UK after Canada and Australia, and Copilot, Perplexity and Google checkout are US-only.

DE.note: Only Alexa+ is available, in early access since May 2026, and Amazon does not list its shopping features by country; Google agentic checkout leaves Europe out (US and Australia only).

BR.note: Magalu's AI assistant Lu sells inside WhatsApp: shoppers search, pay by Pix or card and track the order without leaving the chat (7.7 million users since November 2025). Alexa+ in early access (since June 2026) also orders from Amazon after you confirm. ChatGPT, Copilot and Perplexity checkout are not offered in Brazil, and Gemini's Buy button needs Google Pay agentic checkout, which is US and Australia only.

MX.note: Only Alexa+ is available, in early access since January 2026, and it can order and pay for you (for example food orders). Gemini lists Mexico for shopping, but its Buy button needs Google Pay agentic checkout, which is US and Australia only; no ChatGPT, Copilot or Perplexity checkout is offered, and no Mercado Libre or Walmart México checkout inside a chat was found. Liverpool has only announced groundwork (November 2025, with commercetools) to let shoppers buy in ChatGPT "where supported"; no live launch was found.

CL.note: No in-chat checkout found: Gemini lists Chile for shopping, but its Buy button needs Google Pay agentic checkout (US and Australia only), Copilot Checkout is US only, and Alexa+ is not in Chile. Jumbo's AI WhatsApp assistant (launched June 2026, later reported nationwide) builds a cart, but you finish and pay on jumbo.cl or in its app. Lider's web assistant Lider iA adds recipe items to the cart, and we found no chat checkout from Falabella, Ripley or Lider. Still low confidence: only trade press covers Jumbo, and searches of Cencosud and Falabella sites found no primary page.

Rappi's WhatsApp ordering assistant was a beta in December 2025 and we found no statement that you can pay inside the chat, and we found no chat checkout from Éxito or Falabella.

capabilities.name: Marketplace agent buys for you
capabilities.question: Can a marketplace's own AI agent buy things for you?

US.note: Amazon's Alexa for Shopping (with Rufus) can auto-buy at a set price for all US customers, Walmart's Sparky auto-reorders repeat items, and Amazon Buy for Me (buying from other brand sites) is still a beta for some US users.

GB.note: Only Amazon's Alexa+ in early access can order from Amazon for you; Rufus works in the UK, but its Auto Buy and Buy for Me are documented only in the US.

evidence.title: Alexa+ international launch
Alexa for Shopping (US only)

DE.note: Only Amazon's Alexa+ in early access (since May 2026); Rufus is live in Germany, but its Auto Buy is documented only in the US.

evidence.title: Alexa+ international launch

BR.note: Magalu's own agent, Lu, places orders for shoppers inside WhatsApp (7.7 million users since November 2025), and Amazon's Alexa+ in early access (since June 2026) orders from Amazon after you confirm. Mercado Libre is testing a buying agent (MAGO) that is not launched, Casas Bahia's WhatsApp assistant only gives advice, and iFood's Ailo hands the cart to the iFood app to pay.

MX.note: Only Amazon's Alexa+ in early access (since January 2026) can buy from Amazon for you. Walmart México's Sparky (in its app since 24 September 2026) helps find and compare products, and its press release does not mention adding to cart or paying, Mercado Libre's buying agent is still in testing, and no Rufus launch in Mexico was found.

CL.note: No marketplace buying agent found: Jumbo (Cencosud) has a WhatsApp AI that builds a grocery cart in Santiago and Valparaíso, but you pay on jumbo.cl or in its app; Falabella: no customer buying agent found in searches (only internal AI work); Mercado Libre's buying agent is not launched, Lider has a web assistant (Lider iA) that fills a cart from recipes but does not pay; no Ripley agent was found, and Alexa+ is not in Chile. Low confidence: Chile claims rest on trade press, with no Cencosud, Falabella, Ripley or Lider primary page found.

evidence.title: Mercado Libre IA: claves para el futuro del retail 2026

CO.note: Rappi announced a WhatsApp AI assistant in September 2025 that takes orders in plain language by text or voice note. Its Colombia manager said in December 2025 it ran as a beta, with a wider launch planned for 2026; no general launch was confirmed. No Éxito or Falabella buying agent was found (Éxito has an older WhatsApp ordering chatbot from 2020), and Mercado Libre's buying agent is not launched. Low confidence: only trade press covers Rappi; rappi.com and about.rappi.com showed no announcement.

companies.name: OpenAI
companies.role: Co-created the Agentic Commerce Protocol and lets ChatGPT buy from merchants, now mainly through merchant apps, plus a UPI pilot in India.

companies.name: Google
companies.role: Runs agentic checkout and Universal Cart in AI Mode and Gemini on its open Universal Commerce Protocol, and is testing Flipkart checkout in India.

companies.name: Microsoft
companies.role: Copilot Checkout lets US shoppers buy from PayPal, Stripe and Shopify merchants inside Copilot.

companies.name: Perplexity
companies.role: Instant Buy lets US users pay merchants with PayPal inside Perplexity answers.

companies.name: Amazon
companies.role: Alexa+ and Alexa for Shopping (with Rufus) order, auto-buy and use Buy for Me on other sites for customers; outside the US Alexa+ is in early access.

companies.name: Walmart
companies.role: Sparky, Walmart's shopping agent, automatically reorders repeat items for US customers; Walmart México added Sparky to its app in September 2026 for product advice.

companies.name: Flipkart (super.money)
companies.role: Flipkart's payments app super.money is rolling out agents that shop on Flipkart for users, and Flipkart is Google's checkout test partner in Gemini.

companies.name: Razorpay
companies.role: Agentic Payments lets Indian merchants take UPI payments from ChatGPT and Claude in a pilot.

companies.name: NPCI
companies.role: Runs UPI, whose Reserve Pay and UPI Circle features let AI agents pay without a PIN prompt each time, in pilot.

companies.name: Anthropic
companies.role: Claude can order from Zomato, Swiggy and Zepto with UPI in an Indian pilot.

companies.name: Stripe
companies.role: Agentic Commerce Suite and Shared Payment Tokens let merchants list products for agents and accept agent payments.

companies.name: Shopify
companies.role: Agentic Storefronts puts store catalogs into ChatGPT, Google AI Mode and Gemini, Copilot and Meta Muse, for stores in any country selling to US, Canadian or Australian shoppers.

companies.name: PayPal
companies.role: Agent Ready and Store Sync let PayPal merchants be found and paid in Copilot, Perplexity and Google AI checkout.

companies.name: Meta
companies.role: The Muse agent can shop and pay through Stripe Link and Shopify connectors in the US and Canada.

companies.name: Mercado Libre
companies.role: Is testing a shopping assistant and a planned buying agent (MAGO) for its marketplace and Mercado Pago; nothing has launched in the target countries yet.

companies.name: Magazine Luiza (Magalu)
companies.role: Its AI assistant Lu sells inside WhatsApp, from product search to Pix or card payment and order tracking.

companies.name: Rappi
companies.role: Announced a WhatsApp AI assistant for ordering in plain language and by voice note in Colombia; no launch is confirmed yet.

repos.name: Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP)
repos.role: Open standard from OpenAI and Stripe that lets an AI agent check out a cart at a merchant on behalf of a buyer.

repos.name: Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP)
repos.role: Open protocol, led by Google with retailers and platforms, that lets an AI agent find products, build a cart and pay at any merchant that supports it.

repos.name: Medusa
repos.role: Open-source commerce engine whose store and admin APIs let agents browse products, build carts and place orders.

repos.name: Saleor
repos.role: Headless commerce platform with a GraphQL API (and an official MCP server) that agents can use to search products, manage carts and place orders.

repos.name: WooCommerce
repos.role: WordPress store plugin that ships a built-in MCP endpoint, so an agent can read products and orders and act on a shop.

repos.name: Spree Commerce
repos.role: Open-source commerce platform with a local MCP server that lets an agent manage a store through chat.

repos.name: Vendure
repos.role: Headless commerce platform whose typed GraphQL shop API is built to be called by LLM tools, MCP servers and agent frameworks.

repos.name: Bagisto
repos.role: Open-source store and multi-vendor marketplace platform from India, with official agent skills and an MCP server for AI tools.

repos.name: Beckn-ONIX
repos.role: Adapter that connects buyer and seller apps to Beckn open networks such as India's ONDC, so any app or agent can discover and order from any seller on the network.

repos.name: ONDC Protocol Specs
repos.role: API specification of India's Open Network for Digital Commerce, which lets any buyer app search and order from sellers on any other app.
